content.user_title: Audit Codebases and Write Execution Plans
content.value_statement: Codebase improvement work often fails when findings lack evidence or execution detail. This skill audits the repository and writes focused plans another agent can execute.
actual_capabilities: Maps repository structure, conventions, commands, and verification gaps.
Audits bugs, security, performance, tests, architecture, dependencies, docs, and roadmap options.
Vets subagent findings against source files before reporting them.
Ranks findings by impact, effort, fix risk, and confidence.
Writes self-contained plan files with scope, steps, tests, and done criteria.
Supports quick, standard, deep, branch, plan, review-plan, execute, reconcile, and issue workflows.
limitations: Does not directly edit source files during normal planning.
Requires repository access for meaningful evidence and file-line references.
Command execution depends on the host agent and user permissions.
Generated plans can drift when the code changes after planning.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Maintenance Work
use_cases.description: A project maintainer identifies high-value fixes and receives execution-ready plans with clear verification gates.

use_cases.title: Prepare Agent Handoffs
use_cases.description: An engineering lead turns selected findings into self-contained plans for a lower-cost execution agent.

use_cases.title: Review Branch Risk
use_cases.description: A reviewer audits changed files and separates newly introduced risks from existing project debt.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Repository Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use improve quick to review this repository. Focus on the highest-confidence bugs, security issues, and missing verification.

prompt_templates.title: Focused Test Planning
prompt_templates.prompt: Use improve tests. Audit critical paths with weak coverage and write plans for the top three testing gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Branch Change Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use improve branch. Classify findings as introduced or pre-existing, then plan only the introduced risks.

prompt_templates.title: Deep Multi-Area Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use improve deep. Audit security, performance, tests, architecture, and direction. Then write plans for the findings I select.

output_examples.input: Use improve quick on a small TypeScript CLI.
output: A concise findings table with file-line evidence, impact, effort, risk, and confidence.
A recommended order for the top plans and any verification baseline work.
A branch-scoped audit that labels findings as introduced or pre-existing.
A plan for each selected introduced risk, with scope and done criteria.

output_examples.input: Use improve plan for a known authentication cleanup.
output_examples.output: A single handoff plan with current-state evidence, ordered steps, tests, verification commands, and stop conditions.

best_practices: Start with quick or focused mode when the repository is large.
Choose findings before plan generation so plans stay relevant.
Review generated plans again after major code changes.
anti_patterns: Using it to directly implement routine changes in the main worktree.
Publishing security plans as public issues without review.
Treating low-confidence findings as fixes without investigation.

faq.question: Does this skill change my source code?
faq.answer: Normal planning mode does not edit source files. It writes plan files for later execution.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it run commands?
faq.answer: It may run read-only analysis commands when the host agent allows them. Issue publishing requires an explicit user request.

faq.question: What kinds of findings does it look for?
faq.answer: It reviews bugs, security, performance, tests, architecture, dependencies, tooling, docs, and roadmap options.

faq.question: How does execute mode work?
faq.answer: Execute mode delegates one plan to a separate executor in an isolated worktree when the host supports it.

faq.question: Is it suitable for private repositories?
faq.answer: Yes, when used in a private environment. The skill tells agents not to copy secret values into findings.
